label: Quote
description: Something a customer said, with their name and role.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: The words
fields.help: Quote them as they said it, without quotation marks. Two or three sentences read best.

fields.name: attribution
fields.label: Said by
fields.help: The person's name. An unattributed quote reads as invented.

fields.name: role
fields.label: Role or company
fields.help: Optional, for example Head of Facilities, Northgate Practice.

fields.name: portrait
fields.label: Portrait
fields.help: Optional. A small square photograph works best.

fields.name: portraitAlt
fields.label: Portrait description
fields.help: Describes the portrait for screen readers and when the picture fails to load. It is not shown on the page.
